summary: No work-count omission identified in the inlined distributed row/nonzero/repetition loops.

source_evidence.claim: computeRowRange handles the remainder and full CSR partitions are scattered. The original CLI iteration count is broadcast, then the timed iter/i/j nest recomputes every local row from every nonzero each iteration. No reference-output substitution or iteration shortcut is present.

compiled_evidence.claim: mul/add a16d/a176 are inside the nonzero loop. Row backedge a193 -> a130 covers local rows; repetition backedge a19c -> a120 restarts them for each parsed iteration between MPI_Wtime calls.
